steps.tx: Skin infections account for fifteen percent of dermatology visits, with cellulitis incidence twenty-five per one thousand per year and impetigo affecting ten percent of children. Dermatophytosis has prevalence twenty-five percent globally, while scabies affects two hundred million people yearly. These share the final common pathway of **barrier breach** with bacterial, fungal or parasitic colonisation of stratum corneum.

steps.tx: Risk factors include **diabetes** with two fold cellulitis risk, lymphoedema, venous ulcer, athlete foot in seventy percent of tinea pedis cases plus **immunosuppression** with HIV and chemotherapy. Household crowding raises scabies spread, with three or more contacts affected in eighty percent of outbreaks. Tinea capitis peaks at five to nine years of age.

steps.tx: Staphylococcus aureus releases **exotoxins** that open tight junctions, while Streptococcus pyogenes produces M protein that blocks phagocytosis. Dermatophytes secrete **keratinases** that digest keratin and evade immunity by suppressing Toll like receptor signals. Sarcoptes scabiei burrows at zero point five mm per day and releases faecal pellets that trigger Th two itch.

Sarcoptes scabiei burrows slowly and releases faecal pellets that trigger strong itch.

steps.tx: Cellulitis shows acute spreading **erythema** with warmth, pain and a sharp advancing edge, often after a portal in seventy percent of cases. Impetigo crusts are **honey coloured** with honey crust exudate in eighty percent of children. Scabies classic signs are burrows in finger webs, wrist and genitals with itch worse at night in ninety percent.
steps.say: Cellulitis shows acute spreading redness with warmth, pain and a sharp advancing edge, often after a portal in seventy percent of cases. steps.tx: Tinea corporis forms **annular plaques** with central clearing and scaly raised edges, while tinea capitis shows **black dot** pattern with broken hairs. Erysipelas has a sharply demarcated raised edge without bullae, and necrotising fasciitis shows crepitus with pain out of proportion. Pityriasis versicolor gives hypo or hyperpigmented macules with fine scale.

steps.tx: First test is **clinical pattern** plus **KOH mount** for dermatophytes showing septate hyphae at eighty-five percent sensitivity. Gold standard is **fungal culture** on Sabouraud agar at twenty-five degrees for two to four weeks. Bacterial culture of pus confirms Staphylococcus aureus in seventy percent of impetigo, while skin scraping finds mites in sixty percent of scabies.

steps.tx: Impetigo needs topical **topical antibiotic** two percent ointment three times daily for five days, or oral **anti-staphylococcal antibiotic** five hundred mg four times daily for seven days in extensive disease. Cellulitis starts with IV broad spectrum antibiotic one g twice daily or oral **oral antibiotic** in mild cases. Tinea corporis needs terbinafine two hundred fifty mg daily for two weeks.

steps.tx: Tinea capitis needs griseofulvin five hundred mg daily for six to eight weeks because topical agents fail in hair shafts. Scabies needs **permethrin** five percent cream applied overnight and repeated on day eight, treating all contacts. Necrotising fasciitis needs emergency debridement within six hours plus broad spectrum cover four point five g every six hours.

steps.tx: Complications include **necrotising fasciitis** with mortality twenty-five percent when debridement is delayed beyond twenty-four hours, plus **osteomyelitis** in five percent of diabetic foot ulcers. Impetigo can trigger post streptococcal glomerulonephritis in five percent of children at two weeks. Chronic tinea in twenty percent of cases becomes **resistant** with terbinafine and needs itraconazole one hundred mg daily for four weeks.

steps.tx: Most bacterial skin infections cure in seven to fourteen days with **response rates** over ninety percent on first line therapy. Dermatophytosis relapses in twenty percent within one year without footwear change. Diabetic foot ulcers recur in forty percent in a year, and scabies reinfection occurs in fifteen percent when contacts are missed.
